'''Bela Vistal''' was a large [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] [[City/Legends|city]] nestled in the southeast mountains of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Description==
Bela Vistal was a large town located two hundred kilometers from [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="AaC" /> The city was an important trading outpost. Nestled in a serene mountain valley, it was considered by many to be an ideal tourist destination for those on a modest budget. Its isolation and tall mountains made it a favorite among hikers and climbers, as well as adventurers who yearned for a beautiful view and fresh air. However, the city could be dangerous for inadvertent travelers.<ref name="SWG:BV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Starting Location: "Bela Vistal"</ref>

One of the most well-known attractions in Bela Vistal was the [[Crystal Fountain of Bela Vistal|Crystal Fountain]], a geyser which was transported from the [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat Swamp]] to the center of the town.<ref name="SWG:CFoBV" />

The city was inhabited by mainly [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]], and [[Drall/Legends|Drall]], with one of the city's neighborhoods primarily made up of Selonian residents.<ref name="AaC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Was a riot in Selonian enclave of Bela Vistal city that started crisis, and was Selonians who riot after intolerable and forever provocation from the Human League but I not think was we who started it.|[[Dracmus]]|<ref name="Assault at Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>}}
As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] escalated after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the city eventually became an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] stronghold.<ref name="GG" />

During the [[Corellian Crisis]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], a member of the [[Human League]], a [[Humanocentrism|Human-supremacist]] group with the goals of overthrowing the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government on the planet, threw a punch in the city's Selonian neighborhood, causing a riot to break out. The Human League had intended to start a conflict, but the response from the Selonians and the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] had been bigger than the group was anticipating, as groups of each species began attacking the others and rioting spread across the entire planet.<ref name="AaC" />

==Inhabitants==
The following individuals were residents or visitors of the city in the time after the Battle of Yavin: [[Dalya]], [[Ging Darjeek]], [[Grondorn Muse]], [[Luthin Dlunar]], [[Palejo Reshad]] and [[Pashna Starkiller (Mon Calamari)|Pashna Starkiller]].<ref name="SWG" />
